howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Fiziksel ve enerji hasarına, degeneration'a çok dirençli — pasif güç kazanan şampiyon kullanma (dirençlerini hızlandırır). Zırh kıran ve fury'li şampiyonlar en iyisi. Zehire karşı tamamen savunmasız.
signatureAbility:
Ionic Recharge
During Ionic Overcharge, Passively Regenerate [10 - 80]% of the Health denied to the Opponent due to any reduced Regeneration Rate. Each tick of this healing cannot exceed [256.31] Health, scaling with Base Health.
When the Opponent gains [180 - 20]% of a Bar of Power from a Passive or Buff within 0.5 seconds, instantly gain 50 Ionic Charges. Then activate Ionic Overcharge.
This also triggers when they gain [32 - 8]% of their Max Health for any reason within 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Count Nefaria's body is composed of Ionic Energy, granting Immunity to Power Steal and Bleed effects, and 90% Shock and Incinerate Resistance.

abilitySections.title: Energy Build Up
content: Whenever the Opponent fills a Bar of Power, they gain 15 Stored Energy.
For every 1% of the Opponent's Max Health or Power they would gain from a Buff or Passive, they gain 2 Stored Energy. This is unaffected by reduced Regeneration or Ability Power Rates.
Every 10 Stored Energy is automatically converted into an indefinite Energy Build Up Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Well-Timed Blocks - Evade
content: When Count Nefaria would Block a Basic Attack or the final hit of a Special Attack with or just after a Well-Timed Block, he has a 100% chance to Evade instead.
This Evade has a cooldown of 11 seconds, but the cooldown is ignored for Evading Special Attacks.
When Evading, Count Nefaria Counter Attacks. On hit this deals a burst of [2,551.8] Energy Damage and inflicts 2 Energy Build Ups.
If the Opponent's Special Attack is punished after Evading it, inflict a [2,750] Energy Vulnerability Debuff for 18 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Ionic Charges
content: Gain 10 Ionic Charges when performing a Well-Timed Block.
Lose 20 Ionic Charges when Count Nefaria would be inflicted with a Bleed effect while fighting a non-Mystic Champion.
Ionic Charges grant up to +[9,356.6] Attack Rating, maxing out at 100 Charges.
They also grant up to +[6,416.67] Physical and Energy Resistance and 90% Degeneration Resistance, maxing out at 100 Charges.

abilitySections.title: Ionic Overcharge
content: At 100 Ionic Charges, activate Ionic Overcharge for 17 seconds. It is paused during Count Nefaria's Special Attacks. Lose 100 Charges when it expires.
During Ionic Overcharge, all of Count Nefaria's attacks are non-contact and deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Additionally, the Opponent's Regeneration and Ability Power Rates are reduced by 95%, and when they gain Ability Power he gains 60% of the Power denied this way.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: The first hit of any Special Attack deals a burst of [5,103.6] Energy Damage if it is the first or second hit after Count Nefaria's Counter-Attack hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final 4 hits each devour 2 Energy Build Ups. This can trigger through Block and is unaffected by Ability Accuracy.
Each devoured Energy Build Up grants 16 Ionic Charges, 2% of his missing Health, and 9% of a Bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, gain a +[1,020.72] Fury Passive per 10 Ionic Charges, each lasting 16 seconds. Max stacks: 15.
The final hit inflicts an Incinerate Debuff, dealing [11,057.8] Energy Damage over 6 seconds.
Against Mystic Champions, inflict a Plasma Debuff instead.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain 50 Ionic Charges, then activate Ionic Overcharge.
Pause Ionic Overcharge for 10 seconds.

When the Opponent gains [180 - 20]% of a Bar of Power from a Passive or Buff within 0.5 seconds, instantly gain 50 Ionic Charges. Then activate Ionic Overcharge.
This also triggers when they gain [32 - 8]% of their Max Health for any reason within 0.5 seconds.
